tagline: EffectCraft on a Selkies web desktop, for motion graphics with compositions, keyframes and effects in the browser.
description: EffectCraft, motion graphics and compositing in the spirit of After Effects, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: EffectCraft
